mapper.select:
select ac.partenId, ac.partenName, ac.deptId, ac.deptName, sum(ac.hxkt) hxkt, sum(ac.zxktxj) zxktxj, sum(ac.zxktxjys) zxktxjys, sum(ac.cgzh) cgzh, sum(ac.xslw) xslw, sum(ac.jczz) jczz, sum(ac.zl) zl, sum(ac.rz) rz, sum(ac.jl) jl, sum(ac.jzbg) jzbg, MAX(COALESCE(hx.ewyyx, '0个（0万）')) AS ewyyx, MAX(COALESCE(hx.edwwy, '0个（0万）')) AS edwwy, MAX(COALESCE(hx.wdswy, '0个（0万）')) AS wdswy, MAX(COALESCE(hx.sdeswy, '0个（0万）')) AS sdeswy, MAX(COALESCE(hx.esdsswwy, '0个（0万）')) AS esdsswwy, MAX(COALESCE(hx.wswwydwswy, '0个（0万）')) AS wswwydwswy, MAX(COALESCE(hx.wsdqswwy, '0个（0万）')) AS wsdqswwy, MAX(COALESCE(hx.qswdybwy, '0个（0万）')) AS qswdybwy, MAX(COALESCE(cg.eyxxx, '0个（0万）')) AS eyxxx, MAX(COALESCE(cg.edwxx, '0个（0万）')) AS edwxx, MAX(COALESCE(cg.wdsxx, '0个（0万）')) AS wdsxx, MAX(COALESCE(cg.sdesxx, '0个（0万）')) AS sdesxx, MAX(COALESCE(cg.esdsswxx, '0个（0万）')) AS esdsswxx, MAX(COALESCE(cg.sswdwsxx, '0个（0万）')) AS sswdwsxx, MAX(COALESCE(cg.dywsxx, '0个（0万）')) AS dywsxx from Alltotle_score ac left join ( select su1.dept_id, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount < 2 THEN h.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS ewyyx, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 2 AND h.amount < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 2 AND h.amount < 5 THEN h.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS edwwy, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 5 AND h.amount < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 5 AND h.amount < 10 THEN h.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS wdswy, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 10 AND h.amount < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 10 AND h.amount < 20 THEN h.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS sdeswy, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 20 AND h.amount < 35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 20 AND h.amount < 35 THEN h.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS esdsswwy, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 35 AND h.amount < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 35 AND h.amount < 50 THEN h.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS wswwydwswy, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 50 AND h.amount < 75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 50 AND h.amount < 75 THEN h.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS wsdqswwy, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 75 AND h.amount < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.amount >= 75 AND h.amount < 100 THEN h.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS qswdybwy from sci_horizontal_apply h join sys_user su1 on su1.user_id = h.user_id where h.state in ('HORIZONTAL_APPLY_PASSED', 'HORIZONTAL_OVER_PASSED') group by su1.dept_id ) hx on hx.dept_id = ac.deptId left join ( select su2.dept_id, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount < 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount < 2 THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS eyxxx, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 2 AND c.amount < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 2 AND c.amount < 5 THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS edwxx, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 5 AND c.amount < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 5 AND c.amount < 10 THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS wdsxx, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 10 AND c.amount < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 10 AND c.amount < 20 THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS sdesxx, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 20 AND c.amount < 35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 20 AND c.amount < 35 THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS esdsswxx, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 35 AND c.amount < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 35 AND c.amount < 50 THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS sswdwsxx, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个（', ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.amount >= 50 THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END), 2), '万）') AS dywsxx from sci_IntraSchPro_apply c join sys_user su2 on su2.user_id = c.first_person_id where c.state = 6 group by su2.dept_id ) cg on cg.dept_id = ac.deptId
AND ac.partenId IN
#{dictVal}
AND ac.partenName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pname}, '%')
AND ac.deptName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dname}, '%')
AND ac.userName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND ac.partenId = #{collegeParentId}
GROUP BY ac.partenId, ac.partenName, ac.deptId, ac.deptName order by ac.partenName asc, ac.deptName asc
